devdoc.details: Deploy behind a proxy and configure the trust provider EOA through `updateTrustProvider`. The owner address, ZKP token, and FeeMaster are immutable.

params.amount: Amount of ZKP rewards to withdraw.

params.newTrustProvider: Address of the new trust provider.

devdoc.title: ComplianceTreasury

OWNER().notice: Governance address allowed to manage the trust provider.

ZKP_TOKEN().notice: ZKP token used when collecting rewards from FeeMaster.

claim(address,uint256).notice: Claims accrued rewards from FeeMaster in ZKP token to the receiver.

trustProvider().notice: Address that is allowed to pull rewards from the FeeMaster. Stored in slot 0.

updateTrustProvider(address).notice: Updates the EOA that is allowed to claim the accumulated rewards.

userdoc.notice: Lightweight upgradeable contract that holds the trust provider role for FeeMaster.
